benefits.name: Aer Lingus Companion Ticket
benefits.description: An economy companion ticket for a flight on Aer Lingus between the US and Ireland, earned after $30,000 in purchases in a single calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $30,000 in purchases posted by Dec. 31 of the calendar year. Companion ticket is valid for 12 months from date of issue, economy only, one per calendar year, valid only on Aer Lingus flights between the US and Ireland, and the companion must travel with the cardmember on both the outbound and return journeys. No taxes and fees apply to the companion ticket.

benefits.name: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Priority boarding for the primary cardmember and authorized users on Aer Lingus flights operated directly between the US and Ireland.

benefits.name: Anniversary Bonus Avios
benefits.description: 2,500 bonus Avios awarded each account anniversary year.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash, plus up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. Quarterly non-restaurant order discount available through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Auto-enrolls in DashPass at the standard rate after the complimentary period unless cancelled.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked baggage is delayed more than 6 hours.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.
benefits.terms: New York residents: limited to $2,000 per bag, $10,000 per trip.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.
benefits.terms: New York residents: limited to 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Flights purchased directly with Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, and LEVEL.
Hotel accommodations booked directly with the hotel.
